processTitle: Tell us what you need. We take care of the rest.
processIntro: At EACC Jardines we work for homeowners, residential communities, businesses and professionals. From a small job to ongoing maintenance or a larger project, we put our experience at your service to find the right solution.
stepsText: Explain the work you have in mind. Send photographs, the location and a short description, or contact us directly.
We assess your needs, the space and the best approach. Where necessary, we arrange a site visit.
We present a proposal tailored to your needs, with a clear, no-obligation quote.

scopeTitle: What we can do for your space
prepareText: Send the location, photographs and approximate measurements. Let us know about access and whether you need a one-off job or ongoing maintenance. This helps us assess the scope and agree the next steps.
faqAnswer: We assess the condition of the space and the scope of the work. Where necessary, we arrange a visit before preparing the proposal. Quotes are free of obligation.
toolsIntro: Simple tools to help prepare measurements before requesting a quote. Results are estimates and do not replace an on-site survey.
areaIntro: Calculate the square metres of a rectangular, circular or triangular space and add an optional planning allowance for materials.
spacingIntro: Estimate planting positions along a line or in a rectangular grid, leaving your chosen margin at the edges.
invalid: Enter valid positive numbers within the stated limits.
areaNote: Rectangle: length × width. Circle: π × radius². Triangle: base × perpendicular height ÷ 2. The material allowance is not a purchase recommendation.
spacingNote: Spacing is measured centre to centre. The first position starts at the margin; another is added for each full interval. Grid positions are rows × columns. Obstacles, mature plant size and species requirements are not included.
privacyText: Forms and calculators run in your browser. This website does not store enquiries: continuing sends the prepared message to WhatsApp, where you decide whether to send it. Photographs and the logo belong to EACC Jardines. Google Fonts may be requested when the page loads.
analyticsText: If configured and accepted, Google Analytics measures page usage. We do not send form fields or calculator measurements to Analytics. You can withdraw consent in cookie preferences.
cookieText: We can use Google Analytics to learn which pages are useful. We only load it if you agree.
analyticsOff: Analytics has not yet been configured.

drainageIntro: Calculate pipe drop and elevations and explore the layout in 3D.
previewNote: Schematic at uniform scale; illustrative pipe and manhole sizes. Motion shows direction, not actual flow rate or speed.
flatDrainage: Zero slope: no gravity flow is shown.
reverseDrainage: Reverse slope: water would move towards the inlet.
drainageNote: Length is horizontal. Drop = length × slope ÷ 100; outlet = inlet − drop. Does not size flow or check regulations.
drainageInvalid: Enter a length from 0.01 to 10,000 m, elevations from −10,000 to 10,000 m and a slope from −100 to 100%.
